desc: Implement a function to compute the next LCS profile given the current profile and a character c.
Initialize the DP: start with profile [0, 0, ..., 0] (length N+1) with count 1.
Iterate M times (for each character in T): for each current profile, for each of the 26 characters, compute the new profile and update the count for the new profile.
After M iterations, aggregate the counts by the last element of the profile (which is the LCS length) to get ans[k] for k=0 to N.
Print the answers ans_0, ans_1, ..., ans_N separated by spaces.
